 Kaitlin Quevedo (No. 86 ranking) will take on Lilli Tagger (No. 53) in the semifinals at the Galaxy Holding Group Guangzhou Open on Saturday, October 31.
 Compared to the underdog Quevedo (+170), Tagger is favored (-222) to advance.

 Tournament: The Galaxy Holding Group Guangzhou Open
